def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if not isinstance(seed_time, pd.Timestamp):
        seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)

    orders = db["orders"]
    items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    entity_set = set(entity_ids)

    features = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))

    defaults = {
        "count_orders": 0,
        "count_items": 0,
        "count_sellers": 0,
        "total_price": 0.0,
        "total_freight": 0.0,
        "avg_price": 0.0,
        "avg_freight": 0.0,
        "std_price": 0.0,
        "std_freight": 0.0,
        "min_price": 0.0,
        "max_price": 0.0,
        "days_since_first": 0.0,
        "days_since_last": 0.0,
        "avg_items_per_order": 0.0,
        "has_sales": 0.0,
    }
    for k, v in defaults.items():
        features[k] = v

    for h in (30, 90, 180):
        features[f"orders_last_{h}"] = 0.0
        features[f"items_last_{h}"] = 0.0
        features[f"revenue_last_{h}"] = 0.0

    features["trend_90_90"] = 1.0
    features["delivered_orders"] = 0.0
    features["delivered_share"] = 0.0
    features["avg_delivery_delay"] = 0.0
    features["review_count"] = 0.0
    features["avg_review_score"] = 0.0
    features["bad_review_share"] = 0.0
    features["review_recency"] = 0.0
    features["payment_count"] = 0.0
    features["payment_value"] = 0.0
    features["avg_installments"] = 0.0

    payment_types = (
        list(payments["payment_type"].unique()) if "payment_type" in payments.columns else []
    )
    for pt in payment_types:
        features[f"payment_type_{pt}"] = 0.0

    # --- Покупки строго до seed_time ---
    items_past = items[
        (items["ts"] < seed_time) & (items["product_id"].isin(entity_set))
    ].copy()

    if len(items_past) > 0:
        g = items_past.groupby("product_id")

        cnt_orders = g["order_id"].nunique()
        cnt_items = g["order_id"].size()
        cnt_sellers = g["seller_id"].nunique()
        total_price = g["price"].sum()
        total_freight = g["freight_value"].sum()
        avg_price = g["price"].mean()
        avg_freight = g["freight_value"].mean()
        std_price = g["price"].std(ddof=0)
        std_freight = g["freight_value"].std(ddof=0)
        min_price = g["price"].min()
        max_price = g["price"].max()
        first_date = g["ts"].min()
        last_date = g["ts"].max()

        features.loc[cnt_orders.index, "has_sales"] = 1.0
        features.loc[cnt_orders.index, "count_orders"] = cnt_orders
        features.loc[cnt_items.index, "count_items"] = cnt_items
        features.loc[cnt_sellers.index, "count_sellers"] = cnt_sellers
        features.loc[total_price.index, "total_price"] = total_price
        features.loc[total_freight.index, "total_freight"] = total_freight
        features.loc[avg_price.index, "avg_price"] = avg_price
        features.loc[avg_freight.index, "avg_freight"] = avg_freight
        features.loc[std_price.index, "std_price"] = std_price
        features.loc[std_freight.index, "std_freight"] = std_freight
        features.loc[min_price.index, "min_price"] = min_price
        features.loc[max_price.index, "max_price"] = max_price
        features.loc[first_date.index, "days_since_first"] = (
            (seed_time - first_date).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
        )
        features.loc[last_date.index, "days_since_last"] = (
            (seed_time - last_date).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
        )

        items_per_order = cnt_items / cnt_orders.astype(float)
        features.loc[items_per_order.index, "avg_items_per_order"] = items_per_order

        for h in (30, 90, 180):
            cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=h)
            recent = items_past[items_past["ts"] >= cutoff]
            if len(recent) > 0:
                rg = recent.groupby("product_id")
                r_orders = rg["order_id"].nunique()
                r_items = rg["order_id"].size()
                r_rev = rg["price"].sum()
                features.loc[r_orders.index, f"orders_last_{h}"] = r_orders
                features.loc[r_items.index, f"items_last_{h}"] = r_items
                features.loc[r_rev.index, f"revenue_last_{h}"] = r_rev

        c90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
        c180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)
        rec90 = (
            items_past[items_past["ts"] >= c90]
            .groupby("product_id")["order_id"]
            .nunique()
        )
        prev90 = (
            items_past[(items_past["ts"] >= c180) & (items_past["ts"] < c90)]
            .groupby("product_id")["order_id"]
            .nunique()
        )
        trend = (rec90 + 1.0) / (prev90.reindex(rec90.index).fillna(0) + 1.0)
        features.loc[trend.index, "trend_90_90"] = trend

        # Доставки: только те, чья дата доставки уже наступила (строго < seed_time),
        # иначе этой информации на момент seed_time ещё нет.
        order_info = orders[["order_id", "order_status",
                             "order_delivered_customer_date",
                             "order_estimated_delivery_date"]]
        items_ord = items_past.merge(order_info, on="order_id", how="left")

        delivered = items_ord[
            (items_ord["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna())
            & (items_ord["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)
        ]
        if len(delivered) > 0:
            d_orders = delivered.groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
            features.loc[d_orders.index, "delivered_orders"] = d_orders
            d_share = d_orders / cnt_orders.reindex(d_orders.index)
            features.loc[d_share.index, "delivered_share"] = d_share

            delay = (
                delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"]
                - delivered["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
            ).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
            delivered = delivered.assign(delay=delay)
            avg_delay = delivered.groupby("product_id")["delay"].mean()
            features.loc[avg_delay.index, "avg_delivery_delay"] = avg_delay

    # --- Отзывы: только те, что созданы до seed_time ---
    if "review_creation_date" in reviews.columns:
        reviews_past = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time]
    else:
        reviews_past = reviews.iloc[0:0]

    mapping = (
        items_past[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates()
        if len(items_past) > 0
        else items_past[["product_id", "order_id"]]
    )
    if len(mapping) > 0 and len(reviews_past) > 0:
        joined = reviews_past.merge(mapping, on="order_id", how="inner")
        if len(joined) > 0:
            rev_agg = joined.groupby("product_id").agg(
                review_count=("review_score", "count"),
                avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
                bad_share=("review_score", lambda s: float((s <= 2).mean())),
                last_review=("review_creation_date", "max"),
            )
            features.loc[rev_agg.index, "review_count"] = rev_agg["review_count"]
            features.loc[rev_agg.index, "avg_review_score"] = rev_agg["avg_review_score"]
            features.loc[rev_agg.index, "bad_review_share"] = rev_agg["bad_share"]
            rec = (seed_time - rev_agg["last_review"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
            features.loc[rev_agg.index, "review_recency"] = rec

    # --- Платежи: только по прошлым заказам и только записи, существующие на seed_time ---
    if len(mapping) > 0 and len(payments) > 0:
        pay_merged = payments.merge(mapping, on="order_id", how="inner")
        if "ts" in pay_merged.columns:
            pay_merged = pay_merged[pay_merged["ts"] <= seed_time]
        if len(pay_merged) > 0:
            pay_agg = pay_merged.groupby("product_id").agg(
                payment_count=("payment_value", "size"),
                payment_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
                avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
            )
            features.loc[pay_agg.index, "payment_count"] = pay_agg["payment_count"]
            features.loc[pay_agg.index, "payment_value"] = pay_agg["payment_value"]
            features.loc[pay_agg.index, "avg_installments"] = pay_agg["avg_installments"]

            for pt in pay_merged["payment_type"].unique():
                col = f"payment_type_{pt}"
                if col not in features.columns:
                    features[col] = 0.0
                sub = pay_merged[pay_merged["payment_type"] == pt]
                if len(sub) > 0:
                    ptype_count = sub.groupby("product_id").size()
                    features.loc[ptype_count.index, col] = ptype_count

    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    features = features.fillna(0).astype(float)
    return features
